notes: This mapping is limited to the Flush Queue Request exception: the FQR recipient receives Flush Queue Grant rather than Time Advance Grant. The test does not claim coverage of every possible time-advance service or provider conformance. The Java source is API-only parity; Java provider execution remains unsupported.

requirements.statement: The portable scenario asserts that its Flush Queue Request recipient receives one Flush Queue Grant after the queued interaction and receives no Time Advance Grant. The other tested TAR, TARA, and NMRA recipients receive Time Advance Grant callbacks and no Flush Queue Grant.
